newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: COLLY COTTON SAYS PESTICIDE CLAIM DISMISSED.
newsitem.headline: COLLY COTTON SAYS PESTICIDE CLAIM DISMISSED.

text.p: Cotton producer and trader Colly Cotton Ltd said on Thursday a cross claim against the company by ICI Australia over the pesticide Helix has been dismissed.
Colly said ICI had agreed it has no further claim against Colly in the proceedings.

The Federal Court found in June that ICI had in some cases breached its duty and care over the manufacture and distribution of the pesticide, which cattle producers in two states alleged contaminated their stock.
Colly said ICI had sought to claim Colly was liable for part payment of damages suffered by farmers.
It said the action was settled with no damages to be borne by Colly or its insurer.
